description: This file implements WiFi device management and interface control for a device, including singleton patterns for device instances, API handlers for WiFi profile and interface status, and JSON-RPC communication with external services. It includes conditional compilation for different environments (RDKV_NM) and external dependencies such as JSON parsing and system-specific WiFi control.

classes.name: WiFiDevice
classes.description: Represents a WiFi device instance with singleton management, context handling, and lifecycle control.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi
classes.description: Represents the WiFi interface control, providing getters and setters for WiFi parameters and status, with singleton management.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of WiFiDevice for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a WiFiDevice instance.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes and deletes all WiFiDevice instances.

methods.name: WiFiDevice::shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the WiFi device (stub implementation).

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of hostIf_WiFi for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a hostIf_WiFi instance.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes and deletes all hostIf_WiFi instances.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_RadioNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of WiFi radio entries via IARM bus call.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_SSIDNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of WiFi SSID entries via IARM bus call.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_AccessPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns a fixed number of WiFi access points (1).

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_EndPointNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns a fixed number of WiFi endpoints (1).

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::get_Device_WiFi_EnableWiFi
methods.description: Gets WiFi enable status via IARM bus call or JSON-RPC depending on environment.

methods.name: hostIf_WiFi::set_Device_WiFi_EnableWiFi
methods.description: Sets WiFi enable status via IARM bus call or JSON-RPC depending on environment.
